text:
For a countably infinite structure \(A\) in a computable signature
(\cref{def:p03-w03-p03-063-computable-signature}), a presentation with domain
\(\mathbb N\) is \emph{computable} when its atomic diagram
(\cref{def:diagrams}), coded by the numbering of literals in
\cref{def:p03-w03-p03-063-sentence-coding}, is decidable.  A finite structure has
no presentation with domain \(\mathbb N\); it is presented on an initial
segment of \(\mathbb N\) (\cref{thm:p03-w03-p03-063-domain}).
